Hidden K Stables · Day 15 · Saturday, October 10

Abbott Overnight

You asked for the rider to look normal, and for the whole game to look, run and feel better. Madison now sits Abbott like a hunter rider. Abbott is back in the ring (he had disappeared), with a bridle that fits. The game runs more than twice as fast, and the picture is sharper.

Worked from 12:42 to about 6:45 a.m. on branch day15-claude. Every change was committed separately, with the checks below run along the way. Nothing was pushed or exported, the jump and scoring rules were not touched, and Madison's save was compared after every run.

At a glance

  • Madison's seatIn the saddle behind the withers, legs down his sides, feet in the irons, hands on the reins.
  • Abbott visible againThe Day 14 model was 100× too big in the game. Fixed, with his chestnut coat on.
  • About 100 fpsUp from 35–40. The scoreboard was reading a file from disk every frame.
  • Sharper pictureSMAA replaces FXAA, and small objects stop casting shadows.
  • Real tack and fencesA fitted bridle, a reshaped saddle, hedge brush and flower beds.
  • Life in the ringReins along his neck, a live score board, a crowd that watches and waves, a pat after a clear round, a tail that flows and ears that listen.
  • Small fixesWalking Madison faces forward, F11 toggles full screen, the title photo drifts in, and the results card marks the way on.
  • Checked all nightSelf-tests, the playtest and two timed rides after the changes. Madison's save was never touched.

Before and after

Smaller things that add life

Smoother

The same ride, on this computer, with the computer rider and vsync off. The graphics card was never the problem: it needs about 2.5 ms a frame. The processor was waiting on the scoreboard, which read and parsed the fence list from disk every frame just to show "Fence 1 of 3 · white vertical."

Start of the night
37 fps
This morning
104 fps
12.3 ms → 0.035 msScoreboard work each frame. The fence list is read once now.
2–8k → about 2kDraw calls each frame. Flowers and bolts no longer cast shadows, and each fence fill is one piece.
7% instead of 13%How much the anti-aliasing softens the picture (SMAA replacing FXAA).

The ride times must stay within 0.10 s of the start of the night. That proves the horse moves exactly as before, since everything tonight was visual or performance work. Self-tests now guard tonight's fixes. The seat test measures where she actually sits (it would have caught the giant horse), the score board test looks at the board in the arena, and five new tests check that the scoreboard stays cheap every frame, that walking Madison faces forward, that his tail hangs at the canter, that a gamepad can reach Options from the pause menu, and that a won rosette stays on his bridle when he lifts his head.

For you to decide

  • "Best · 0 faults · 5.86s" on the titleThat is Madison's saved beginner record, and no real round is that short. It almost certainly came from old automated test runs before saves were protected (her save also lists about 1,900 beginner rounds). I left it alone because it's her data. Say the word and it can be reset.
  • No music yetThe game has hoofbeats, horse and rider sounds, and ambience, but no music. Music makes a big difference. Pick a style you like, and a free track can go in.
  • The photos_jpg folderIt was deleted from the repo folder before tonight, outside this session. I didn't commit that deletion; restore it or confirm it should go.
  • MergingTonight's work is on branch day15-claude, on top of Cursor's day14-horse. Nothing is merged to main.

Play this version

Press Win+R, paste this, and press Enter. The game opens in a 1600×900 window. Press F11 (or Alt+Enter) for full screen; it remembers your choice.

godot --path "E:\Workspace\Madison\game"

Try a Lesson first. Then try Walk on the title menu, which now has Madison walking the course properly.
